component_evidence_attribute.description: Kind of source that supports the constituent list.

LEXICAL_MATCH.description: Lexical (token-overlap / normalized-name) match against an ontology label or synonym.

CAS_RN_CROSS_REFERENCE.description: Identity established via CAS Registry Number cross-reference rather than ontology label match.

MANUAL_CURATION.description: Manually curated evidence supplied by a human reviewer (distinct from CURATOR_JUDGMENT, which records the decision rather than the source of evidence).

MANUAL_REVIEW.description: Identity confirmed during a manual review pass.

CURATOR_CONFIRMED_SYNONYM.description: Curator confirmed a synonym match found by tooling.

SOURCE_LABEL.description: The upstream label explicitly enumerates the constituents.

CURATED_DATASET.description: A reviewed structured curation table supplies the constituents.

MANUAL_CURATION.description: A curator established the constituent list and recorded the rationale.

RECIPE_SOURCE.description: A cited medium or stock-solution recipe supplies the constituents.

PUBLICATION.description: A publication supplies or directly supports the constituent list.

rules.condition: Exact new/modified mapping evidence expresses documented agent-authored mapping, registry, source-scope or synonym judgment, even when supported by primary citations.
rules.reason: Represents the recorded agent contribution without asserting human evidence supply. It is a provenance type, not a statement that underlying primary data are fabricated.

rules.condition: Exact full entry is confined to a directly verified ontology database fact/match; the original captured term proves the claim at its actual scope.
rules.reason: Require exact capture hash and term/field locator for this entire entry; a URL or ontology-named source is insufficient.

rules.condition: Exact full entry records an explicit cross-reference supplied by another database with matching substance/form/scope.
rules.reason: Do not promote an agent-inferred source-to-owner identity or a recipe association to an explicit database cross-reference.

rules.condition: Human reviewer actually supplied the particular evidence, with attributable inspected record of that contribution.
rules.reason: LLM assistance elsewhere does not negate a real human contribution. A human-authored publication or human-operated service alone is not evidence of human supply of this MIM claim.

rules.condition: Full entry unchanged under duplicate-aware predecessor comparison.
rules.reason: Inheritance is not a new agent assertion; historical provenance truth remains unassessed unless separately established.

rules.condition: Historical source evidence is modified/reframed by an agent, but exact original human/agent source attribution remains unclear.
rules.reason: Classify ambiguous_needs_review; retain exact old/new values and separate original evidence from new contextual note. No forced retype.

rules.condition: ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum MANUAL_CURATION, EvidenceSourceEnum, mapping_quality, history, other similarly spelled enum.
rules.proposal: out of this mapping-evidence replacement scope
rules.reason: Definitions differ; infer neither defect nor replacement from spelling.
